Probe The Base: Interactive Space Station Management & Simulation

About the Project Probe The Base is an interactive web-based simulation platform that puts players in direct operational command of exploratory outposts on the Moon and Mars. It merges real-world environmental data from NASA APIs with tactical, real-time base management powered by Phaser.

Core Objective Beyond traditional gameplay, the project features an embedded Academy module designed to test engineering judgment and critical decision-making under pressure. Whether balancing power loads on the Lunar surface or mitigating life-support emergencies on Mars, every choice directly dictates mission survival.

Key Features

  • Cockpit Telemetry Experience: Interactive command dashboards providing immediate visual feedback and emergency alerts.
  • Interactive Training Academy: Integrated evaluation modules testing scientific and engineering principles during active missions.
  • Performance & Progression Badges: Dynamic achievement system rewarding efficient crisis management and system stabilization.
  • Comprehensive User Manual: Full visual documentation built right into the platform for frictionless onboarding.
